message:
I've often thought about how reliant we’ve become on our phones and gadgets. They’re great for keeping us organized, but when they die at the worst moment, it can feel like we’re left in the dark. That's why I find it comforting to have a solid plan in place, one that doesn’t depend solely on technology. 

Taking a little time to think through our family’s emergency plan can offer a sense of security and calm. After all, it’s not just about having a backup battery; it’s about knowing we’re prepared, come what may. Have you thought about your family’s plan lately?
